sample_unit: ward-based ChatGPT sessions (conversation logs and shorthand notes)
unlisted_practices: Developing a team code of conduct on ethical and appropriate use of LLMs on clinical wards
Integrating a public LLM into attending rounds for medical education and discrete knowledge queries

screen.reason: An exploratory qualitative study evaluating the real-time use of ChatGPT-3.5 during daily attending rounds on an inpatient service. While a code of conduct was developed to guide usage, the study does not test or compare outcomes of a deployment practice.
